subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider now that Google's public docs present the surface as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: Source inspection proves the current visible copy is still `Google Vertex AI`, but the issue's exact proposed wording differs from Google's current docs and provider-id renames would be compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels and docs to a bridged current Google name while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id. ([cloud.google.com](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs))

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the current OpenClaw label until maintainers decide the Google SDK/API ecosystem has moved far enough to rename visible provider copy.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Adopt the reporter's shorter wording even though I did not find that exact phrase on the checked official Google docs page. ([cloud.google.com](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs))

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels and docs to a bridged current Google name while keeping `google-vertex` as the stable provider/config/API id. ([cloud.google.com](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs))

likelyOwner.reason: The live discussion already asks this login to choose the label, and this login has the strongest recent history on adjacent provider/session surfaces.
